CRASH HELMET (SPECIFICATIONS) RULES, 1978
CRASH HELMET (SPECIFICATIONS) RULES, 1978
[Gazette of N.-W. F. P., Extraordinary, 23rd May 1978]
No. SO. III (IND) B-I/78.-In exercise of the powers conferred by
section 96 of the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (W. P. Ordinance
No. XIX of 1965), the Government of North-West Frontier Province is pleased to
make the following Rules, namely :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(I) These Rules may be called the
Crash Helmet (Specifications) Rules, 1978.
(2) They shall come into force at once.
2. Specification of Crash Helmet.--A Crash Helmet shall be made of
such material and meet such other requirements as are specified in Pakistan
Standard No. 1402 of 1978 established and published by the Pakistan Standard
Institution under the Pakistan Standard Institution (Certification Marks
Ordinance, 1961 (LXVIIII of 1961), in the Gazette of Pakistan, dated the 26th
April 1978.
